summary: The reviewed governing rule for the three-outcome pilot retires mandatory duplicate packets, typed returns, reducer views, fixed five-minute issue polling and unchanged-status reports after protected delivery. One six-field issue and native PR/check identities carry current state; exact native joins replace routine hash and file-correspondence recitations, while missing or ambiguous joins require a targeted read and remain unknown. The existing CI evidence integrator owns automatic per-PR acceptance-result producer/reader qualification separately; only facts actually qualified may replace manual verification. Check pending issue replies at agreed response/escalation deadlines and each session start/resume, with complete-thread recovery when the prior read is unreliable; optional notifications are not a gate. Measure the 80% coordination-effort target during ordinary delivery, without making measurement an activation gate or claiming unsupported savings. Retain one independent source review, relevant tests and final-head required CI, operation-specific acceptance, credential custody, original unknown reservations and .103 attempted-unknown/unreplayed. Source merge does not prove installed adoption or automatic result qualification.
title: Run three outcomes with one issue, deadline replies and scoped CI evidence
